completion.label: local resource available >1e-12 only where completed_mask; unknown -1
completion.payment: detect_paid >= detect_requested; memory/write payment is separate
completion.support: fixed port_mask, old survivor>1e-12, active>=.02*survivor. Host completed_mask certifies port coverage; adapter checks stored payment/capacity/carrier, not physical geometry.

history_scope: one material scope per stream; caller must retain actual carrier/shift/keep/receipt provenance. Do not concatenate fixed coordinates across movement without provenance.
arrays: exact dtype/shape/C-byte SHA; no rounding/interpolation, no tolerance added
task: single capacity field; cue×mapping chooses one supplied side in stable/reversal; iid chooses one side independently of cue, not two independent Bernoulli ports
limits: no host call or physical reconstruction
active/pending are public, and may already encode history
absolute public step is included; policy must not use hidden reversal schedule/seed
initial capacity is nonzero; no new commitment can retain an existing configuration
resource is a same-step pulse; current resource is zero at legal commitment, by task construction
ability is a priced function of tissue, not extra biomass; newborn has no inherited ability
